summary: An established Abu Dhabi and Dubai law firm appears to lose enquiries to a missing contact form and generic calls to action.

findings.problem: The Send message section appears to show a heading but only an image of a form, so there is no working contact form.
findings.cost: Prospective clients cannot write to the firm from the page.

findings.problem: The only calls to action appear to be Read more and View our services, with no book a consultation prompt.
findings.cost: Visitors have no clear next step.
findings.fix: A consultation button on every service.

findings.problem: Typos such as inter national and the advent of Al appear, testimonials appear to end with 123456, and Arbitration appears to link to the homepage.
findings.cost: Typos and leftover text weaken trust in a law firm.

findings.problem: The footer appears to give no street addresses for either office, and the Winner award appears with no description.
findings.cost: Clients want to see where you are and what you won.
